name: Jesus Christ
overview: Scripture reveals Jesus Christ as the eternal Word who was with God and is God, who took on human flesh and dwelt among us, embodying grace and truth. His coming was foretold as a miraculous virgin birth, fulfilling the sign of Immanuel, meaning 'God with us.' Through His suffering and wounds, He bore the punishment for our sins, providing healing and peace. God's love is demonstrated in giving His only begotten Son, that all who believe in Him may receive eternal life and favor with the Lord.
